title: Tom's Active Day
text:
Tom likes sports. Every morning he runs in the park. He jumps over small rocks and throws a ball to his dog. After that, he swims in the lake.

On weekends, Tom climbs a big tree with his sister. They read books under the tree. Then they cook lunch together. Tom loves to cook pasta.

questions.text: What does Tom do every morning?
options: He reads books under a tree.
He cooks lunch with his sister.

questions.text: What do Tom and his sister do under the tree?
Why does Tom probably enjoy the weekends?
options: He has to go to school all day.
He can be active and spend time with his sister.
He does not like being outside.
He must work in the park.

questions.text: How does Tom probably feel about cooking?
options: He does not know how to cook.
He feels afraid of the kitchen.

vocabulary.definition: goes up something using hands and feet
a large area of water surrounded by land

paragraph_translations: Том любить спорт. Кожного ранку він бігає в парку. Він стрибає через маленькі камені і кидає м'яч своєму псу. Після цього він плаває в озері.
На вихідних Том лазить на велике дерево зі своєю сестрою. Вони читають книжки під деревом. Потім разом готують обід. Тому дуже подобається готувати пасту.
